subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can listen and colour clothes correctly.
I can read A birthday party and answer Yes or No.
I can write about my clothes with I'm wearing ... and My ... is / are ...

tf.s: In the example, their hijabs are red.
In the example, their baseball caps are green.
In A birthday party, the dad is wearing a dishdasha.
tf.why: Our dad is wearing a dishdasha.

tf.s: The mum's and sister's hijabs are blue.
The dad is wearing a baseball cap.

tf.why: Well done! His sandals are brown.

tf.s: In the text, His dishdasha means the dad's dishdasha.
tf.why: His is for a boy or a man.

tf.s: We say They're hijabs are red.
tf.why: We say Their hijabs are red.

tf.s: We write My shoes are black. for more than one shoe.

boxes.q: Their hijabs are red. Which colour do you use?
What colour is the dad's dishdasha?
What colour are the dad's sandals?
Is the dad wearing a baseball cap?
Who does Their mean in Their hijabs are blue?
boxes.why: Their means our mum and our sister.

boxes.q: Which word is from the birthday text?
boxes.why: There is cake at the birthday party.

mcq.q: What is the dad wearing in A birthday party?
mcq.why: He is wearing a dishdasha and a hat.

mcq.q: Which words are from the birthday text?
mcq.why: The text is about a birthday party.

mcq.q: Which sentence is from the listening?
o: They're wearing hijabs. Their hijabs are red.
Our dad is wearing a dishdasha.
mcq.why: The listening is about red hijabs and purple caps.

o: I'm wearing a ... and ... My ... is ...
When do you go to bed?
How many desks can you see?
mcq.why: We write I'm wearing ... and My ... is / are ...

mcq.q: Choose the right word: ___ hijabs are red.
mcq.why: Their shows the hijabs belong to them.

mcq.q: Write about yourself: a white dishdasha.
Two friends wear white dishdashas. Write two sentences.
o: They're wearing dishdashas. Their dishdashas are white.
They wearing dishdashas. They dishdashas are white.
We're wearing dishdashas. Our dishdasha is white.
Their wearing dishdashas. They're dishdashas are white.

mcq.q: In Their hijabs are blue, who are they?
mcq.why: Their is about mum and sister.

mcq.q: Why do we write His dishdasha is white?
o: Because it is about one man, the dad.
Because it is about two girls.
mcq.why: His is for a boy or a man.

mcq.q: Which sentence about the text is wrong?
o: The dad is wearing a baseball cap.
mcq.why: The dad is wearing a hat, not a baseball cap.
